issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, Keno Funds column 2,572.48
issues.issue: Category is inferred from the fund column only. Keno Fund investments (CDs) rose from 56,248.18 to 58,252.34 (+2,004.16) while the fund's only receipt is 2,572.48, so much of this may be CD interest (investment income) rather than keno proceeds. Already marked review.
